options.name: panes
options.description: Two to ten panes: { content: Node, label, size?, min?, max?, collapsible?, collapsed? }; lengths in px (number or '240px') or '%'.

options.name: orientation
options.description: horizontal: panes side by side (vertical separators); vertical: stacked panes.

options.name: sizes
options.description: Restored sizes in percent per pane (from aui-change); overrides the panes' size.

options.name: step
options.description: Pixels a separator moves per arrow key press.

properties.name: sizes
properties.description: Every pane's size in percent of the space between separators.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Back to the initial sizes and collapsed states (no event).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the panes, separators, observers, and listeners.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user resized, collapsed, expanded, or reset: { sizes, collapsed, index, reason }; persist sizes and pass them back as sizes.

contentAreas.name: panes
contentAreas.description: Each pane's content (a Node, which may be another splitter's host).

cssClasses.name: aui-splitter__pane | __pane--collapsed
cssClasses.description: A pane and a collapsed pane (hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-splitter__separator | __separator--collapsed
cssClasses.description: A separator (role=separator) and one next to a collapsed pane.
